question: What is the probation period for a Band L2 employee?
reference: 6 months

question: What is the notice period for a confirmed L4 employee?
reference: 90 days

question: What are the core collaboration hours?
reference: 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM IST

question: What is the shift allowance for the afternoon shift?
reference: INR 350 per day

question: How many casual leaves do employees get per year, and can they be carried forward?
reference: 8 days; carry forward is not allowed

question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
reference: For more than 2 consecutive days of sick leave

question: How long is maternity leave for the third child?
reference: 12 weeks

question: Who can apply for a sabbatical and for how long?
reference: Confirmed employees with at least 4 years of continuous service; unpaid, up to 6 months

question: How many days per week must employees work from the office?
reference: A minimum of 2 days per week

question: What is the performance bonus target for Band L5 employees?
reference: 15% of fixed annual pay, paid in the June payroll

question: How much group medical insurance cover does the company provide?
reference: INR 5,00,000 per family per year (floater)

question: What is the annual learning budget per employee?
reference: INR 40,000 per financial year

question: What is the hotel limit per night in a metro city for an L3 employee?
What is the reimbursement rate per km for a two-wheeler?
reference: INR 6 per km

question: Can employees do part-time teaching outside work?
reference: Yes, if it does not compete with the business, uses no company resources, is outside working hours, and has written approval from the reporting manager and HRBP

question: What is the time limit for filing a POSH complaint?
reference: Within 3 months of the incident; the IC may extend it by 3 more months

question: How long is a Performance Improvement Plan?
reference: 60 days, extendable once by 30 days

question: Within how many days is the full and final settlement processed?
reference: Within 45 days of the last working day, after assets are returned and clearances complete

question: After how long can a former employee be rehired?
reference: After a gap of 6 months, if they left in good standing

question: What changed in version 3.2 of the handbook?
reference: Paternity leave 7 to 10 days, Work From Anywhere 15 to 20 days, learning budget INR 30,000 to 40,000

question: Can I get paid for my unused vacation days when I quit?
reference: Yes, earned leave is encashed at exit, up to 30 days, calculated on basic pay, as part of the full and final settlement

question: What daily allowance does an L5 employee get when travelling within India?
reference: INR 2,500 per day

question: If I resign while still on probation, how much notice do I have to give?
reference: 15 days

question: A colleague keeps making inappropriate comments about my appearance. Who should I report this to?
reference: The Internal Committee (IC), in writing within 3 months, at ic@novatech-example.in or to any IC member

question: My manager has not done anything about my concern on project allocation for two weeks. What can I do next?
reference: Escalate to the HRBP (unresolved after 7 working days); if still unresolved, to the Grievance Committee chaired by the CPO

question: I left my office laptop in a cab. What should I do?
reference: Report it to the IT Service Desk within 2 hours of discovery, at extension 4357 or itsupport@novatech-example.in

question: Can I paste client data into ChatGPT to summarise it quickly?
reference: No. Client data must not go into public generative AI tools; only AI tools approved on NovaHub may be used with company data

question: I joined in November last year. Will I get a bonus this June?
reference: No. Employees must have joined before 1 October of the previous year to be eligible

question: Does the company help with daycare costs for my toddler?
reference: Yes, creche reimbursement of up to INR 5,000 per month per child under 6, for up to 2 children

question: Someone in finance is faking invoices. How can I report it without revealing my name?
reference: Report anonymously to the Ethics Helpline (ethics@novatech-example.in) or the third-party hotline on NovaHub; reports go to the Audit Committee
